errors.text: The proposed descriptor-based phase-formation model is not the target machine-learning interatomic potential coupled to free-energy perturbation.
It omits the replacement of EAM potentials and thermodynamic integration by MTP and FEP, respectively.
The mechanism does not address atomistic phase-space sampling, MTP–DFT energy-difference variance, electronic free energy, or solid-state short-range order.
Neither cited source supports accurate or efficient prediction of melting properties using the proposed model.
The falsification experiment lacks a named benchmark, quantitative error tolerance, baseline comparison, and computational-cost metric.
